scope: PvZ 1 PC Adventure; reference for GOTY 1.2.0.1096, not locally calibrated

units.health: HP at full health, including listed equipment
units.damage: HP per hit unless otherwise labelled
units.seconds_per_tile: approximate unimpeded movement at normal game speed; smaller is faster
units.time: game seconds, not wall-clock time during pause

cautions: Static planning reference only. These are not current HP, measured speed, timers or observed equipment states.
Use for firepower, spending and spacing decisions. Do not compute or track live remaining HP from this table.
Listed body HP can include a headless dying phase; full HP divided by damage is not an exact number of shots needed to neutralize a zombie.
Speed varies with animation, slowing, obstacles and phase. A listed phase does not mean that phase was observed.
Plant packet recharge and attack/arming/production intervals are different. Current card usability still comes from observation.

Ordinary persistent plants do not expire on a fixed lifetime. A full-health Wall-nut lasting about 40 seconds assumes one ordinary zombie chewing continuously at 100 HP/s, no slow or special attacks. This is not a live survival countdown.
Null or absent numbers mean unverified or not applicable; never replace them with a normal zombie or plant default. No PvZ2 upgrades, Versus Mode or mods are included.

cherry bomb.usage: single use; some instant-kill interactions bypass normal HP

wall-nut.usage: blocks walking zombies; vaulting, ladders, crushing and theft can bypass durability

potato mine.usage: single use; vulnerable before armed; requires lead distance
potato mine.uncertainty: The PvZ1 article says both 14 and 15 seconds. Use 15 as a planning reference, not a measured readiness flag.

snow pea.usage: slowing is conditional on a successful applicable hit; shields and immunity matter

repeater.uncertainty: The Repeater article says it fires two peas at the Peashooter's rate and rounds that rate to 1.5 s; the Peashooter article gives 1.425 s. Its trivia notes it sometimes fires one pea before two.

chomper.usage: swallows edible targets; cannot swallow again while digesting; inedible targets are bitten instead

tall-nut.usage: blocks vaulting and pogo; does not prevent every bypass or crushing attack

pumpkin.usage: protective shell; special attacks can bypass ordinary chewing

pole vaulting.mechanic: one vault; Tall-nut blocks the vault

screen door.mechanic: shield can be bypassed by applicable piercing/lobbed attacks

ducky tube.mechanic: HP depends on visible normal/cone/bucket variant; do not assume plain body

snorkel.mechanic: submerged targets evade many direct projectiles

zomboni.mechanic: variable vehicle speed; crushes plants and leaves ice, not ordinary chewing

bobsled.mechanic: team of four; do not confuse team HP with one zombie

jack-in-the-box.mechanic: box explosion destroys nearby plants; explosion timing is not a fixed countdown here

balloon.mechanic: ground projectiles cannot normally hit flying target

digger.mechanic: can attack defenses from the left after surfacing

bungee.mechanic: drops vertically and steals plants; not a lane-walking zombie

ladder.mechanic: ladder can allow following zombies to cross defenses

catapult.mechanic: can stop to throw projectiles, then move and crush plants

gargantuar.mechanic: crushes plants; throws an imp when damaged; ordinary wall chewing times do not apply

imp.mechanic: Adventure baseline; I Zombie has different HP and speed
